    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
FROM 
    customers
INNER JOIN 
    yearmonth
ON

    Segment
